column3: “the sons of Israel” renders “the people Israel.”
“the Levitical priests” renders “the priests, the Levites.”
“the Lord of all the earth” renders the Hebrew closely; NASB reads “the ark of the covenant of the Lord,” supplying “of.”
NASB puts the note on the Jordan overflowing in parentheses; the Hebrew has no parenthesis.
“completely cut off” renders “were finished, were cut off.”
